thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: [ALERT] Spike in 502/504 observed from ELB frontend in us-west-2c. elb_5xx_rate jumped from ~3/min to ~210/min. Trigger at 2024-12-04T18:12:16Z.

emma (infra): Confirming in grafana. Several targets in TG frontend are UNHEALTHY in us-west-2c. Paging oncall.

ben (sre): grabbing logs. Are we seeing ENI errors or host-level disk thrash?

raj (networks): ENI error counters high on a subset of instances in us-west-2c. `ethtool -S` shows tx errors and dropped packets. Kernel logs show repeated "device reset" messages for e1000e on some hosts. Raising AWS support case.

olivia (support): Incoming customer reports for streaming connections failing and 502s. High-volume customers: ACC-773, ACC-779. Sending initial customer advisory now.

ben (sre): immediate mitigation idea: remove the affected AZ targets from the ELB target group to stop routing to flaky hosts, allow traffic to be served from other AZs. Can someone run deregister?

raj (networks): I can deregister the specific targets and add AZ-level out-of-service. Running commands now: 

```
# find instances in azc
aws ec2 describe-instances --filters Name=availability-zone,Values=us-west-2c Name=tag:role,Values=frontend --query 'Reservations[].Instances[].InstanceId'

# deregister from TG
aws elbv2 deregister-targets --target-group-arn arn:aws:elasticloadbalancing:us-west-2:987654321:targetgroup/tg-frontend/abcd --targets Id=i-0f1e2d3c4b5a6
```

emma (infra): also lowering Route53 weight for us-west-2 to shift traffic to us-west-1 temporarily. TTL set to 20s for emergency.

chris (oncall): I'm taking over incident coordination. ben, status on ELB rates after deregister?

ben (sre): 5xx rate dropped from 210/min to ~35/min within 5 minutes. Some latency still elevated for flows routed cross-region. ASG is replacing unhealthy instances in the affected AZ.

raj (networks): AWS case opened: 1122334455. AWS logs indicate "Ena/ENI resets observed on hypervisors" and internal remediation is in progress. They advise avoiding the affected hypervisors and keeping traffic away from the AZ until their sweep completes.

deploy-bot: :man_technologist: Auto-scaler triggered replacement: 3 instances terminated, 3 new instances launched in us-west-2c (but ASG will wait for healthy checks before re-register).

olivia (support): Customer advisory sent: "We are aware of elevated 502/504 errors for connections routed through us-west-2c. We have shifted traffic and are working on remediation. Recommended client action: retry on 5xx; short-lived streaming sessions may reconnect." Ticket numbers: INC-5601, INC-5602.

chris (oncall): Action items: 1) keep affected AZ drained at ELB until AWS confirms fix, 2) monitor ASG replacements for flapping, 3) keep Route53 weight shifted for 1 hour and reevaluate, 4) prepare postmortem and runbook updates. I'll own comms.

ben (sre): enabling control-plane routing fallback to prefer replicas in us-west-2a/b then us-west-1 to avoid cross-AZ edge cases.

emma (infra): done. Switched smart-routing: prefer local AZ replicas then other AZs in same region, then cross-region.

--- 45 minutes later ---

ben (sre): ELB 5xx back near baseline. New instances passed health checks; ENI error counters on replaced hosts are stable. AWS says they completed remediation on some hypervisors but will keep an eye.

raj (networks): AWS update: cause = planned fabric maintenance that impacted a subset of hypervisors leading to ENI resets. They recommend not launching into the same host pool for 60 minutes. Case 1122334455 will remain open for monitoring.

olivia (support): Notified affected customers that services have returned to normal but some transient reconnects occurred. Closing high-severity customer tickets.

chris (oncall): beginning 30m handoff to ben (next oncall). Incident severity reduced to monitoring. Please add RCA notes and assign postmortem owners.

ben (sre): RCA notes draft: root cause: AWS hypervisor/network maintenance produced ENI resets; mitigation: AZ drain from ELB, ASG replacements, Route53 weight shift, control-plane routing fallback; impact: ~12% of traffic, streaming sessions experienced reconnects, several customers saw transient 502/504s.

emma (infra): I'll update runbook steps for AZ drain and short-ttl Route53 shifts. PR link: https://github.com/redwoodinc/runbooks/pull/241

raj (networks): follow-ups: improve alert thresholds for ENI-level drops and automate AZ-level drain playbook.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Incident INC-2024-1789 marked resolved at 2024-12-04T21:46:40Z. Postmortem due in 72h.

chris (oncall): closing thread; will reopen if regressions. Thanks team :pray:
